name: manual_82885a
claim: Before running a test suite on a machine with live services, check for tests that call lifecycle routes unfaked, and run a fixed non-empty file list: a pattern that matches no files makes pytest collect the whole suite. Tests of stop or restart routes must fake the port lookup, the signal call and the process spawn.

decisions.notes: orama-system portal lifecycle tests called the real stop and restart routes, which signal whatever listens on the service ports, and most likely stopped a running portal. Fixed in 720b07e9, which was not on main when recorded.
